problem: B-603 Batch-xfade export was 38 frames longer than a 95-segment timeline
cause: Seeked filter inputs retained non-zero PTS and per-input fps filters independently rounded short slot durations upward before concat/xfade
rule: For multi-input concat/xfade, normalize every input with setpts=PTS-STARTPTS and cap the finished composite once to round(sum(timeline slot durations) * fps) frames; verify the final frame count against the video timeline
applies_to: FFmpeg filtergraph exports with many trimmed inputs, concat, xfade, or batch stream-copy concat
